snippet.title: Sarge (Arcade) Gameplay
snippet.description: Sarge is an arcade game released by Bally Midway in 1985. Two players play at once, switching between tanks and helicopters. Players can fight each other. The game has two sets of joysticks.   #sarge  #arcade  #mame  #arcadeclassic #arcadegames #arcadegaming
